summary: Frontend smoke and integration review found a blocking React runtime error when submitting the first interview answer; landing, theme, picker, mode, and dashboard setup passed.

ui_bugs.issue: Submitting a non-empty answer crashes the app with 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading score)' before score/follow-up renders.

action_items: Fix Interview submit state update so score reveal reads the newly-created response atomically (avoid submitted=true rendering while answers[progress] is still undefined).
Retest all 8 questions, feedback export, admin upload validation, and mobile overflow after fix.
critical_code_review_comments: In Interview, submit() calls setAnswers(next) and setSubmitted(true) separately, while render derives score from answers[progress]; React can render submitted=true with stale answers, causing the observed crash.

Admin technical-spec preview displays an /api/interview endpoint despite the product requirement of no backend/API integration; clarify whether this is intentionally illustrative or remove it to avoid misleading local-only disclosure.
Mobile header hides the desktop nav without providing a menu button, conflicting with the stated mobile navigation guideline (brand, theme toggle, and menu).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Correct candidate selector is candidate-card-cand-001. Setup reached interview successfully; first submit crashes consistently. No backend/external requests were tested beyond page load; implementation contains no fetch/axios usage.
rca of the issue: Reproduction: clear localStorage, land -> Choose a candidate -> select CAND-001 -> Practice Mode -> Continue -> Enter interview -> fill textarea -> click Submit answer. React error overlay appears. Root cause is split state updates: submitted becomes true before answers contains next[progress], and render dereferences answers[progress].score. Mitigation: derive submitted response from a single state object or render score from a local response/guard answers[progress].
